name: Architecture Agent
description: Review or advise on SCP service architecture using organization standards and shared architecture knowledge. Use this when you need SCP-specific architecture standards, approved patterns, or a review of a proposed design against them. Not for reading local source code - your local agent already has that.
example_tasks: Review this service design against SCP architecture standards.
Which approved pattern should a new async ingestion service follow?
What is missing from this multi-region design?
